title: Exquisite Flaky Egyptian Eggs Frittata
description: A jammy and flaky Egyptian dish featuring eggs and fry grind rice, perfect for meal prep and gluten free friendly, cooked in individual mini cocotte vessels.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt until well combined.
Add the chopped onion, diced tomato, and chopped bell pepper to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the fry grind rice to the bowl and stir until the rice is evenly distributed.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Brush the individual mini cocotte vessels with olive oil.
Divide the egg mixture among the mini cocotte vessels.
Bake the frittatas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove the frittatas from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the frittatas warm and enjoy.
